verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec for Plaid Identity Verification. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json). The llms.txt file, markdown docs and MCP server are different capabilities and are not an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
